note: v3 replaces v2's independent column bootstrap with a 3-step pipeline: joint row resampling (preserves inter-column correlation), single sort (enforces max>=mean>=min), quantile mapping (fixes residual KS without re-sorting), and a light swap (fixes any lingering inversions). This achieves Mean KS ~0.03 vs v2's 0.27 and v1's 0.34.
